summary: A selector chooses which elements a rule styles. p picks an element type, .officer picks a class, and #president picks one id.
notes: A dot means class (.officer). A hash means id (#president). No symbol means element (p).
Diego has both .officer and .new, so his line is bold, blue, and italic.
h1, #president is a group: the comma means the rule applies to both.
pitfall: Leaving off the dot (officer { }) looks for an <officer> element, which does not exist, so nothing changes and there is no error.
